meta.title: Worship Flow
meta.description: ProPresenter, video production, creative media and automation for churches. Your team opens a ready-to-run file every Sunday.

sections.kicker: ProPresenter, Video and Creative media for churches
sections.title: Open the file. Run Sunday.
sections.body: Worship Flow is your church's ProPresenter and creative partner. Playlists, lyrics, sermon slides, video and graphics are prepared during the week, so your volunteers walk in to a service that is ready to run.
sections.note: Last-minute changes happen; call or text us if you need help.
sections.consoleHint: Click any slide to take it live

slides.line: One cue fires slides, lights and cameras

sections.title: Many specialties, one creative partner
sections.body: More than a decade of church production, from church plants to multi-campus teams.

items.title: ProPresenter
items.body: Weekly playlists, styled lyrics, crafted sermon slides and remote management. We keep your library clean and your themes consistent, and your team opens a file that is ready to run.

items.title: Video production and editing
items.body: Story videos, announcements, website hero videos and three-camera livestreams.

items.title: Creative media
items.body: Series graphics, announcement slides, digital signs and social content that match your church's look.

items.title: Automation
items.body: ProPresenter, ATEM and Lightkey talking to each other through RossTalk and MIDI, so one click fires slides, cameras and lights.

items.title: Training
items.body: Volunteer training, ProPresenter operator coaching and on-site city-wide training events.

items.title: Live events
items.body: A ProPresenter machine with four outputs and an operator who runs the whole event. We built every file for a conference with 6 stages and more than 70 presenters.

sections.title: On site for your event
sections.body: Conferences, camps and city-wide nights. We bring a ProPresenter machine with four outputs and an operator who runs the whole event, and we can add a three-camera livestream.
facts: Every ProPresenter file built for a conference with 6 stages and 70+ presenters
Three-camera livestream to YouTube, Facebook or RTMP

sections.title: Sermon series media packs
sections.body: Series looks built for real Sundays. Each pack has the title graphic, PSD, socials, blank slide, video and countdown.

items.title: Romans 8: Declared series pack
items.desc: A complete series look: title graphic, layered PSD, social graphics, blank slide, series video and countdown.
items.details: The full look for the Romans 8: Declared series, built for and used on real Sundays. Put the title graphic on your screens and stream, use the blank slide behind scripture and sermon points, post the social graphics to promote the series, and open the service with the video and countdown. Change the text and colors in the included PSD.

sections.title: Your week, from plan to Sunday
sections.body: Onboarding takes one 30 to 45 minute meeting. After that, every week runs the same way.

items.title: Share your service plan
items.body: Planning Center, chord charts, a Word document or a quick call.

items.title: Rehearsal file built
items.body: Worship, sermon and media organized in ProPresenter.

items.title: Rehearse and send changes
items.body: Notes, a recording or a simple form. Your operator doesn't have to be there.

items.title: Final flow with sermon notes
items.body: Scripture, points and graphics added to the service.

items.title: Final check
items.body: Lyrics, scriptures, layouts and cues reviewed. Late changes still accepted.

items.title: Open and run
items.body: Your team walks in to a ready-to-run file.

sections.title: How a creative project runs
sections.body: Graphics, video and training each follow a simple plan, so you always know what happens next.

tracks.name: Graphic design
tracks.intro: For a sermon series or event look.

items.title: Brief
items.body: Send the series title, scripture, dates and any references. A short call if it helps.

items.title: First look
items.body: A first version of the title graphic for your feedback, so the style is settled before the full build.

items.title: Build the set
items.body: Title graphic, blank slide, social graphics and a layered PSD, matched as one set.

items.title: Add motion
items.body: A series video and countdown built from the same look.

items.title: Deliver
items.body: Files organized and loaded into your ProPresenter playlist, ready for Sunday.

tracks.name: Video production
tracks.intro: For a story video, announcement or ministry video.

items.title: Plan
items.body: A call to find the story, the people and the place.

items.title: Shoot
items.body: A two-hour shoot with two cameras and lighting.

items.title: Edit
items.body: Story cut, color, sound and graphics in post-production.

items.title: Review
items.body: You watch a draft and send changes.

items.title: Deliver
items.body: The final video, ready for your screens and stream.

tracks.name: Training
tracks.intro: For volunteer teams and ProPresenter operators.

items.title: Assess
items.body: We look at your setup, your team and where Sundays get stuck.

items.title: Plan
items.body: A training plan sized to your volunteers and your gear.

items.title: Train
items.body: Hands-on operator training, on site or by screen share.

items.title: Resources
items.body: Training videos your team can rewatch.

items.title: Follow up
items.body: Regular refreshers keep new volunteers up to speed.

items.quote:
Worship Flow is one of the most talented and servant-hearted teams we've had the privilege of working with. They're not only excellent at what they do
- they bring love, humility, and a commitment to excellence to every project, all while faithfully serving the Kingdom of God.
items.name: Dave Prentice

items.quote: WorshipFlow absolutely crushed it for our PACE conference. We had 6 stages and over 70 presenters, each with different types of media and content. He built all the ProPresenter files we needed, and it made our jobs and lives so much easier. Everything he delivered was spot-on and completely perfect.
items.name: Arron Hartt

items.quote: Worship Flow has helped us execute Sunday at a high level all while helping and serving our team.
items.name: Jonathan Hazle

items.quote: I've been doing this for over 20 years. When I need new tech, new processes, new ideas, inspiration, or when I need help, I go to Worship Flow.
items.name: Jeremy Dickerson

items.quote: Worship Flow faithfully serves our church each week, managing ProPresenter, lighting, visuals, and our livestream. His attention to detail creates a seamless worship experience that helps our team and congregation keep our eyes on Jesus.
items.name: Chris Richards

sections.title: Led by Steve Dirks
sections.body: Steve is a production leader with a pastoral heart, based in Pittsburgh. He has run ProPresenter for church plants and multi-campus churches for more than a decade, leads audio, video and lighting teams, and edits video professionally.
sections.body2: People first. Purpose behind every cue.

sections.title: Tell us about your Sunday
sections.body: A 30 minute call is the fastest way to see whether we're a fit. Bring your questions, your ProPresenter version and whatever is frustrating your team.
